question: What scope of understanding is sought regarding the eightfold divisions?
premises: The subject is the division into groups of eight
The aim is to know it fully
The knowing is described as endless or exhaustive
inference: Complete and exhaustive knowledge of the eightfold divisions is sought
uncertainties: The exact sense of anantathā as endlessly or in infinite detail is interpretive
plain_english: I seek to know fully and exhaustively the division into the eight groups of eight.
